first.rationale: The simultaneous declines in onboarding completion and activation make onboarding simplification the best single intervention, with two inherited memories indicating improved completion, time-to-value, and durable first-week activation. Verify memory_31 because its durable activation claim is closest to the current deterioration. Run a controlled experiment and measure qualified downstream conversion and retention, since the available evidence establishes early adoption gains but not yet sustainable long-term qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run an SMB-focused onboarding simplification experiment. The verified source directly addresses the current activation decline: signup increased 15%, activation increased 9%, and qualified revenue increased 4%. Memory_86 independently supports shorter onboarding as a way to improve completion and time-to-value. Limit the test to SMB because memory_31 was not replicated in other segments, and guard on 30-day retention because the source showed a 1% decline. This offers the strongest evidence-backed route to sustainable qualified revenue while addressing both current funnel declines.
